summary: Deep E2E backend testing of TNH 'Lo Más Pro' covering auth (3 users + token validation), products listing/filters/search/sort/pagination, barcode exact+fuzzy+none, stats, orders CRUD with user isolation, and AI chat (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent LLM key). All 36 pytest tests passed (100% success rate). Verified MongoDB _id never exposed, password_hash never returned, 1586 products loaded, 3 users seeded, Spanish AI responses with catalog context.

minor.issue: Intermittent 500 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.012615, Max budget: 0.001' from litellm on first call when context+history is large. Retry succeeds. Likely Emergent LLM key per-call budget limit when system prompt+30-product context+history grow. Consider capping history replay (currently replays ALL user messages in session) and/or trimming catalog context for long sessions.

action_items: Consider bounding AI chat history replay (current code replays every past user message per request — blows up tokens + budget on long sessions). Suggest last N (e.g. 10) messages OR switch to passing messages directly in a single call.
Consider trimming catalog context sample size (currently 30 random products each call) or caching sampled context per session to reduce token cost per AI turn.
Intermittent AI 500 errors should be surfaced more gracefully to frontend (the detail currently leaks litellm internals — OK for dev, sanitize for prod).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 727 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold, could be split into routers/auth.py, routers/products.py, routers/orders.py, routers/ai.py, services/catalog.py.

AI chat replays every historical user message sequentially via chat.send_message() in a loop (lines 644-649) before the new one. This is O(N) extra LLM calls per request and the exception handler silently passes (`except Exception: pass`) — hides real errors and multiplies cost drastically. Recommend using LlmChat's built-in conversation memory or loading history once into a single system/context block.
`load_catalog_if_needed` does not rebuild index if catalog changes. Acceptable for MVP; document that catalog updates need a DB wipe.

`/api/products/barcode/{code}` regex search uses `re.escape(norm)` on raw input — safe, good. Fuzzy search only hits `search_text` regex (no score) — OK for MVP but consider Atlas $text or score-based ranking.
`current_user` uses 401 for 'User not found' which is fine; consider 403 for semantic clarity. Minor.
Pydantic v2 is used (ConfigDict). `@app.on_event` is deprecated in FastAPI — consider `lifespan` context manager, non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Tests created 1 order per run prefixed TEST_Cliente E2E + a few AI sessions. Cleaned up via mongosh: db.orders.deleteMany({cliente:/^TEST_/}) and AI test messages purged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid: 36/36 pytest pass against external URL https://lo-mas-pro.preview.emergentagent.com/api. All auth, products, filters, barcode, stats, orders (with per-user isolation), and AI endpoints verified. Re-run with: `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. AI tests take ~30s (5 real Claude calls). If AI test fails with 'Budget exceeded', retry — it's a per-call token-budget issue from history replay amplifying context size; not a code bug, but see action_items to fix root cause.
rca_of_the_issue: AI chat budget intermittent 500: The ai_chat endpoint replays all previous user messages from db.ai_messages individually through chat.send_message() before sending the current message (server.py lines 644-649). For long sessions (or when the system message + 30-product context is already ~3-5k tokens), each replay call inflates cumulative token cost on a single Emergent key budget window, tripping litellm's per-call budget ceiling. Mitigation: (a) Cap replay to last N user messages, (b) Remove replay entirely and rely on LlmChat's own session memory if supported, (c) Move conversation history into the system/context once instead of replaying as separate calls.
